name: Electrical Engineering
boundaries: Electrical Engineering: fundamental discoveries and enabling technologies within this field. Include cross-field consequences where the central advance belongs to this field; exclude routine incremental optimization. Use the historical breakthroughs in the prompt to calibrate revolutionary impact.

original_dispositions.reason: The historical claims of lossless global transmission and specific global savings are not established consequences.
The particular efficiency, range, and no-line-of-sight combination is not assumed feasible or necessary.

Covered in part. Topological qubits are one possible implementation, not a separate demonstrated route to the listed outcome. Room-temperature operation and the claim that it would break all public-key cryptography are not established.

original_dispositions.original_title: Perfect broadband electromagnetic cloak and lens
original_dispositions.reason: The perfect all-frequency passive cloak as stated faces fundamental limits; a cloak and a super-resolution lens are also distinct capabilities. A bounded, imperfect device might be valuable, but the historical entry does not establish a sufficiently concrete revolutionary system. The cited result is limited to the studied class of finite-sized isotropic passive cloaks and should not be generalized to every conceivable active system.
The concept is retained at the scale where it could change computing, without treating an isolated slope as the breakthrough.
Millions of single-neuron channels and zero power constraints are not assumed necessary.
The addition focuses on a broad, measurable maintenance-cost transformation, not a universal harvester or a free-standing efficiency target.
Its impact is conditional on broad end-to-end advantage; eliminating the von Neumann bottleneck is not assumed.
The revised concept replaces perfect stability and zero blackouts with demonstrable resilience and safe restoration.

Higher data rate alone extends an established capability; the historical claim of terabit links through walls or fog does not establish a specific revolutionary system benefit or demonstrate feasibility. Zero latency does not follow.
